description: Source code for TPS (Throttle Position Sensor) handling in engine control firmware, including functions for reading TPS value, voltage, rate of change, and mock/test functions.

methods.name: setMockTpsPosition
methods.description: Sets mock TPS position for testing purposes.

methods.name: setMockPedalPosition
methods.description: Sets mock pedal position for testing purposes.

methods.name: saveTpsState
methods.description: Stores current TPS state in a lock-free thread-safe manner.

methods.name: getTpsRateOfChange
methods.description: Returns the rate of change of TPS position.

methods.name: getTpsValue
methods.description: Calculates TPS position based on ADC reading and configuration.

methods.name: getTPSVoltage
methods.description: Returns the voltage on the TPS sensor channel.

methods.name: getTPS12bitAdc
methods.description: Returns the 12-bit ADC reading for TPS, with mock support.

methods.name: getPrimatyRawTPS
methods.description: Returns the primary TPS position as a percentage.

methods.name: hasPedalPositionSensor
methods.description: Checks if pedal position sensor is available.

methods.name: getPedalPosition
methods.description: Returns pedal position as a percentage.

methods.name: hasTpsSensor
methods.description: Checks if TPS sensor is available.

methods.name: getTPS
methods.description: Returns current TPS position or magic value if sensor is absent.

methods.name: setBosch0280750009
methods.description: Sets specific TPS calibration values for a VW Passat.

methods.name: convertVoltageTo10bitADC
methods.description: Converts voltage to a 10-bit ADC value considering voltage divider.
